comments.body: Lets discuss adding EIP 8136 as an optional networking EIP to MetaGlamsterdam - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11452

Can we discuss an update to EIP 8045? 
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11443

~~SFI currently has a simple definition of "being included in a devnet" - this is not playing out in reality as there are often reasons not to SFI an EIP even though it's being planned for a devnet and it's resulting in failing to SFI EIPs because the current definition doesn't fit very well so it's unclear when an EIP should actually be SFI'd~~

~~This proposed definition is based on conversation from ACDT https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/74: https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/074#t=1002~~

~~PS commitment: we can auto-monitor devnet EIPs and propose their status change when they meet these requirements~~

~~https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11475~~

talked about it on ACDE (https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2004)

Is this the appropriate week to put forward non-headliners for Hegota? We'd like to (re-)introduce [EIP 7716](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7716) correlated downtime penalties to ACDC and get at least a temp check from teams about CFI, and what they would like to see fleshed out before an SFI decision. :)

[Initial analysis](https://ethresear.ch/t/analysis-on-correlated-attestation-penalties/19244)
[Deeper modelling](https://ethresear.ch/t/diseconomies-of-scale-anti-correlation-penalties-eip-7716/20114)
If we have time, I propose to have a short discussion about https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8205, both to provide a short overview and propose it as a non-headliner for Hegota.

If we have time, I would like to give a quick update on the decisions regarding the spec for EIP-8037 from [Glamsterdam Repricings #6](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2016). It is mostly relevant for bal-devnet-4, so if you prefer to defer this to ACDE next week, happy to do that as well.

## Devnet Plan — Interop Week

| Devnet | Launch | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| [**bal-devnet-4**](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bal-devnet-4) | **Fri 24 Apr** | + [EIP-7976](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7976) (Calldata Floor Cost), [EIP-7981](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7981) (Access List Cost) |
| [**epbs-devnet-2**](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/epbs-devnet-2) | **Fri 24 Apr** | CL spec change only — [alpha.5](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.7.0-alpha.5) spec lands **tomorrow, 17 Apr** |
| [**glamsterdam-devnet-0**](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/glamsterdam-devnet-0) | **EOD day 1 of interop** | [bal-devnet-4](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bal-devnet-4) + [epbs-devnet-2](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/epbs-devnet-2) on top of consensus-specs [**alpha.6**](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.7.0-alpha.6) (includes CL change for [BALs](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7928)). **No new EIPs** — plenty of other bugs to iron out. |
| [**glamsterdam-devnet-1**](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/glamsterdam-devnet-1) | **last day of interop** (if -0 is stable) | Everything in -0 + additions below. If CL Option B or C is picked, bumps to consensus-specs [**alpha.7**](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.7.0-alpha.7). Tests ideally ready beforehand or written during interop. |

---

## Decision needed today: glamsterdam-devnet-1 additions

**EL — pick one on [next week's ACDE](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2015):**

- **Option A.** Nothing beyond bal-devnet-4
- **Option B.** [**EIP-7997**](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7997) — Deterministic Factory Predeploy *(lowest risk)*
- **Option C.** [**EIP-2780**](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2780) + [**7904**](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7904) + [**8038**](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8038) — intrinsic gas / general repricing / state-access repricing bundle *(most testing value)*

**CL — pick one on [today's ACDC](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1990):**

- **Option A.** Nothing beyond epbs-devnet-2
- **Option B.** [**EIP-8045**](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8045) — exclude slashed validators from proposing *(see [EIPs#11443](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11443) and [consensus-specs#5115](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5115) to discuss)*
- **Option C.** [**EIP-8061**](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8061) + [**8080**](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8080) — churn rework + exit-via-consolidation-queue *(coupled pair, ship together; see [consensus-specs#5061](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5061) for 8061 and [consensus-specs#5116](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5116) for 8080)*

> ⚠️ **EL-A + CL-A is not valid** — would make -1 identical to -0.

**Suggestion:** EL Option C for real repricing coverage, CL Option B as a contained CL add. CL Option C is the biggest delta — only worth it if teams want to stress the churn/queue changes, but realistically it's too much to stack on top of all the ePBS bugs we'll be chasing.
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
